mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_server WHERE use_yn='Y') AS "serverCnt", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_agent WHERE status='ACTIVE') AS "agentCnt", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_run WHERE received_at::date = now()::date) AS "runToday", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=ri.run_id WHERE ri.status='CRITICAL' AND r.received_at >= now() - interval '1 day') AS "criticalToday", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=ri.run_id WHERE ri.status='WARN' AND r.received_at >= now() - interval '1 day') AS "warnToday"

SELECT category AS "category", status AS "status", count(*) AS "cnt" FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=ri.run_id WHERE r.received_at >= now() - interval '7 day' GROUP BY category, status ORDER BY category, status

SELECT s.hostname AS "hostname", s.service_name AS "serviceName", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "criticalCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "warnCnt" FROM pmc_inspection_run r JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=r.server_id WHERE r.received_at >= now() - interval '7 day' GROUP BY s.hostname, s.service_name HAVING sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status IN ('CRITICAL','WARN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY "criticalCnt" DESC, "warnCnt" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CAST(r.run_id AS varchar) AS "runId", s.hostname AS "hostname", r.overall_status AS "overallStatus", r.item_count AS "itemCount", r.warn_count AS "warnCount", r.critical_count AS "criticalCount", to_char(r.received_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "receivedAt" FROM pmc_inspection_run r LEFT JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=r.server_id ORDER BY r.received_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ri.item_name AS "itemName", ri.value AS "value", ri.status AS "status", s.hostname AS "hostname", to_char(r.received_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "receivedAt" FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=ri.run_id LEFT JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=r.server_id WHERE ri.category='SVC' AND ri.item_code='SVC_URL_STATUS' AND r.received_at >= now() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY r.received_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_plan_target) AS "targetCnt", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_plan_target WHERE result_status='DONE') AS "doneCnt", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_plan WHERE status='OVERDUE') AS "overdueCnt"
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_dq_rule WHERE use_yn='Y') AS "ruleCnt", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_dq_result WHERE status='FAIL' AND checked_at >= now() - interval '1 day') AS "failCnt"

SELECT to_char(r.received_at, 'MM-DD') AS "day", count(*) AS "runCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "normalCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "warnCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "criticalCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "errorCnt" FROM pmc_inspection_run r WHERE r.received_at >= now() - interval '14 day' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS "openCnt", COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN status='RECURRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS "recurredCnt", COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') AND severity='상' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS "high", COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') AND severity='중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS "mid", COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') AND severity='하' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS "low", COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN status='EXEMPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS "exempted" FROM pmc_vuln_finding

SELECT s.hostname AS "hostname", sum(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "openCnt", sum(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') AND f.severity='상' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "high", sum(CASE WHEN f.status='RECURRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "recurred" FROM pmc_vuln_finding f JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = f.server_id GROUP BY s.hostname HAVING sum(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY "high" DESC, "openCnt" DESC LIMIT 5
